metadata.authority_role: 1008.20.22 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 136) declares legally obligated child support paid to a nonhousehold member an income exclusion, though, placed under 1008.20 Deductions from Income, it still refers to "this deduction". 1008.20 (PDF page 132) lists five deductions and not child support. 1010.20 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 145) says child support paid is not a deduction but an income exclusion. The older 1038.19 (REV:09/2000, PDF page 288) still calls it a deduction. The inconsistency is the source's own.

metadata.authority_role: 1008.20.22 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 136) declares legally obligated child support paid to a nonhousehold member an income exclusion, though, placed under 1008.20 Deductions from Income, it still refers to "this deduction". 1008.20 (PDF page 132) lists five deductions and not child support. 1010.20 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 145) says child support paid is not a deduction but an income exclusion. The older 1038.19 (REV:09/2000, PDF page 288) still calls it a deduction. The inconsistency is the source's own.

metadata.authority_role: 1008.20.22 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 136) declares legally obligated child support paid to a nonhousehold member an income exclusion, though, placed under 1008.20 Deductions from Income, it still refers to "this deduction". 1008.20 (PDF page 132) lists five deductions and not child support. 1010.20 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 145) says child support paid is not a deduction but an income exclusion. The older 1038.19 (REV:09/2000, PDF page 288) still calls it a deduction. The inconsistency is the source's own.

metadata.authority_role: 1008.20.22 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 136) declares legally obligated child support paid to a nonhousehold member an income exclusion, though, placed under 1008.20 Deductions from Income, it still refers to "this deduction". 1008.20 (PDF page 132) lists five deductions and not child support. 1010.20 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 145) says child support paid is not a deduction but an income exclusion. The older 1038.19 (REV:09/2000, PDF page 288) still calls it a deduction. The inconsistency is the source's own.

metadata.authority_role: 1008.20.22 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 136) declares legally obligated child support paid to a nonhousehold member an income exclusion, though, placed under 1008.20 Deductions from Income, it still refers to "this deduction". 1008.20 (PDF page 132) lists five deductions and not child support. 1010.20 (REV:05/2005, PDF page 145) says child support paid is not a deduction but an income exclusion. The older 1038.19 (REV:09/2000, PDF page 288) still calls it a deduction. The inconsistency is the source's own.
